contract.definition: existingUser : User = User.allInstances()->any(u : User | u.UserID = uid), overdueActiveLoans : Set(Loan) = existingUser.LoanedBook->select(l : Loan | l.IsReturned = false and l.OverDueFee > 0.0)
contract.precondition: User.allInstances()->exists(u : User | u.UserID = uid) and existingUser.LoanedBook.oclIsUndefined() = false
